sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-8,000 (levels 1-14). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Crackshot T3, Spirit Lasso unlocked. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Headhunter. Ultimate (Spirit Lasso) is available from Headhunter.

items.name: Headshot Booster
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Headhunter completes 4,800 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Headhunter completes 4.8k weapon in 4800 souls (~4.8 min), 4 purchases

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Powder Keg (2 to 3), Bounce Pad (1 to 2).

items.name: Extended Magazine
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Headhunter completes 3,200 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Headhunter completes 4.8k weapon in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Titanic Magazine
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Headhunter completes 2,400 souls on. Upgrade of Extended Magazine (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Headhunter completes 4.8k weapon in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Headhunter
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 46% weapon damage. Upgrade of Headshot Booster (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Extra Health
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Bullet Lifesteal, 5600 souls (~5.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Rapid Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 6.4k weapon tier, which Swift Striker completes 800 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Swift Striker completes 6.4k weapon in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Swift Striker
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 5,600 to 6,400 invested: bonus 46 to 54% weapon damage.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 8,000-19,200 (levels 14-25). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Powder Keg T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Crackshot, damage) grows from 128 to 176. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Bullet Lifesteal, spirit 4.8k at Rapid Recharge.

items.name: Fortitude
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Bullet Lifesteal completes 1,600 souls on. Upgrade of Extra Health (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.
items.why: imminent: Bullet Lifesteal completes 4.8k vitality in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Bullet Lifesteal
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus.

items.name: Bullet Resist Shredder
items.why: spirit investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Rapid Recharge, 4800 souls (~4.8 min) later and spirit is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Long Range
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 6,400 to 8,000 invested: bonus 54 to 62% weapon damage.

items.name: Extra Stamina
items.why: vitality investment only; its 6.4k tier completes at Stamina Mastery, 6400 souls (~6.4 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 spirit power. Adds 1 more charge to Powder Keg (4 to 5), Bounce Pad (2 to 3). Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

sections.desc: Souls 22,400-46,400 (levels 26-35). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Spirit Lasso T3.

items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 9,600 to 16,000 invested, crossing the 11.2k, 16k tiers: bonus 62 to 86% weapon damage.

items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 16,000 to 22,400 invested: bonus 86 to 100% weapon damage.

items.name: Vampiric Burst
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 8,000 to 12,800 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Sharpshooter? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Stamina Mastery.
sections.desc: Dying after Sharpshooter? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Stamina Mastery.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Slowing Hex early, Disarming Hex later.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry dives you when you land.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Kelvin, Geist.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun and Metal Skin isn't enough.

items.name: Ballistic Enchantment
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Imbued on Powder Keg.
items.legacy_note: Instead of Long Range, High-Velocity Rounds and Sharpshooter when your barrels keep hitting 2+ heroes. On Powder Keg.

items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)
items.legacy_note: Sell Sharpshooter (or Ballistic Enchantment) for this.

items.name: Inhibitor
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 16,000 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Mercurial Magnum
items.caption: Imbued on Powder Keg: the imbue charges up over 14s; the charged use reloads the clip and gives 22% fire rate for 12s. Takes spirit from 4,800 to 11,200 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 38 to 59 spirit power. Replaces Titanic Magazine: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: On Powder Keg. Sell Titanic Magazine for this.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.
